name: LocalSend
summary: Share files between devices on a local network.
description: LocalSend provides device-to-device file sharing across platforms. Discovery and transfer depend on local networking, firewall configuration and receiving-device availability.

license.notes: Upstream license indicator only; redistribution, dependency notices and any model/asset licenses await legal review.

requirements.platform: Upstream targets Windows; the exact Windows version, architecture and compatibility matrix have not been selected or tested.
requirements.hardware: No AI model is required; received files need sufficient local disk space.
requirements.disk: Unknown for a RepoReady distribution. Measure installer, installed files, working data and optional downloads before approval.
requirements.modelDownloads: Core workflow has no required model identified in this research; optional AI features or plugins require separate review.
requirements.network: A reachable local network is needed for device discovery and transfers.
requirements.privacy: Files are sent to selected devices. Verify the recipient and review firewall and network exposure before use.
requirements.apiCharges: No paid API required for the upstream local file-transfer workflow.
